notes: Independent Edge Allocation random multigraph (igraph_iea_game). Pure independent sampling — each edge is one SplitMix64 gen_index draw (or two for loops=true), no rejection. Linear in m; n only affects PRNG modulo distribution. Throughput hovers around 18-24 Melem/s across all three variants, dominated by the SplitMix64 draws and the Vec::push of (u32, u32) into the staging buffer; ~5.5 ms for m=100_000 on Darwin/M-series release build (--sample-size 10 --measurement-time 2 --warm-up-time 1). directed-with-loops takes two PRNG draws per edge yet pays a virtually identical cost to the single-draw no_loops branch (loops branch is cheaper per draw because it skips the v-shift remap; balances out). No oracle baseline: igraph_iea_game is IGRAPH_EXPERIMENTAL in upstream C and RNG state is not portable, so conformance asserts structural invariants only (vcount, ecount EXACT, directedness, no_self_loops when loops=false).
